# PickShrink

> Free online image compressor and resizer. Shrink JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF files, convert between formats, and resize images — all processed locally in the user's browser. No uploads, no watermarks, no account required.

PickShrink is a browser-based image optimization toolkit. Images are decoded, resized, and re-encoded with the browser's own image codecs (plus a WebAssembly AVIF encoder), so files never leave the user's device.

## Tools

- [Compress images](/compress-image): Reduce JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF file size with a quality slider while keeping visual quality.
- [Resize images](/resize-image): Change image dimensions by width, percentage, or maximum longest side without blurring.
- [Bulk image compressor](/bulk-image-compressor): Optimize up to 30 images at once and download them as a ZIP.
- [PNG to JPG converter](/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG files to JPG with a white background for smaller photos.
- [JPG to WebP converter](/jpg-to-webp): Convert JPG photos to modern WebP format for faster websites.
- [WebP to JPG converter](/webp-to-jpg): Turn WebP images into universally compatible JPG files.
- [PNG to WebP converter](/png-to-webp): Convert PNG graphics to WebP to cut file size while keeping transparency.
